big_case.notes: Solicitor General petition on whether the First Amendment bars viewpoint-based termination of competitive federal research grants; a classwide preliminary injunction against a flagship executive policy, with many parallel suits. The subject matter is nationally significant, but the Court denied review at the first conference with no noted dissent or statement, leaving an interlocutory Ninth Circuit ruling in place and deciding nothing; the question remains open for a later final-judgment vehicle. High-stakes subject, modest realized significance for this docket.
